Healthy.symptoms: Uniform green colour, no spots, curling or powdery coating.
Healthy.prevention: Keep scouting weekly, avoid over-watering and maintain balanced nutrition.

Bacterial Blight.symptoms: Angular, water-soaked spots bounded by veins that turn brown; black arms on stems in severe cases.
Bacterial Blight.treatment: Spray copper oxychloride with streptocycline as advised locally; remove badly infected plants.
Bacterial Blight.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed, rotate crops, avoid overhead irrigation and field work when leaves are wet.

Curly Virus.symptoms: Upward or downward leaf curling, thickened veins and stunted growth. Spread by whiteflies.
Curly Virus.treatment: No cure. Remove infected plants and control whiteflies with neem oil or an approved insecticide.
Curly Virus.prevention: Plant tolerant varieties, remove weed hosts and use yellow sticky traps to monitor whiteflies.

Fusarium Wilt.symptoms: Yellowing and wilting of lower leaves, browning inside the stem, plants dying in patches.
Fusarium Wilt.treatment: Soil-applied Trichoderma and carbendazim drench may slow spread. Infected plants cannot be saved.
Fusarium Wilt.prevention: Grow wilt-resistant varieties, rotate with non-host crops and improve soil drainage.

Powdery Mildew.symptoms: White powdery patches on the leaf surface, later yellowing and drying.
Powdery Mildew.treatment: Apply wettable sulphur or a recommended fungicide at the first sign.
Powdery Mildew.prevention: Space plants for airflow, avoid excess nitrogen and scout during cool, humid weather.

Target Spot.symptoms: Circular brown spots with concentric rings, which can cause early leaf drop.
Target Spot.treatment: Apply a recommended fungicide such as mancozeb and remove fallen infected leaves.
Target Spot.prevention: Rotate crops, bury crop residue and avoid dense canopy and prolonged leaf wetness.
